lines.en: I hop my way forward.
On landing I spread flat.

lines.zh: 我的身体是半透明的绿。
lines.en: My body is a translucent green.
I bounce under the vines.

lines.zh: 我跳得不高，但很有节奏。
lines.en: My jumps are low, but steady.
The jungle is damp. I like it.

lines.zh: 我一弹，叶子上就留一块湿。
lines.en: I bounce and leave a wet patch on the leaf.
My rim quivers. Always.
I flatten, then swell back.
I slide a stretch on fallen leaves.
I hop over a root.

lines.zh: 我落在石头上，发出噗的一声。
lines.en: I land on stone with a squelch.
I hop over a puddle.
I land on a vine and it sags.

lines.zh: 我鼓起来，又瘪下去，往前。
lines.en: I swell, deflate, and move on.
I squeeze through a tree hollow.
I rest, wobbling slowly.

lines.zh: 我的里面浮着一点碎叶。
lines.en: Bits of leaf float inside me.
I wait for someone to touch my rim.
I need no feet, yet I move.
In this jungle, I'm among the small ones.

lines.zh: 我把自己拉长，又缩回去。
lines.en: I stretch myself long, then pull back.
Water runs off my skin.
I bounce once. Just habit.
I can't make out distant colors.

lines.zh: 我贴着湿土，慢慢鼓起来。
lines.en: I press against the wet soil and swell slowly.

lines.zh: 我贴着地面，慢慢凉下去。
lines.en: I hug the ground and slowly cool.

lines.zh: 有一点光透过我落在地上。
lines.en: A little light passes through me onto the ground.
You're standing right beside me.
You stepped on my edge.
Touch me and it'll hurt.

lines.zh: 我盯着你，身体一晃一晃。
lines.en: I stare at you, wobbling.

lines.zh: 你的脚就在我边上，挪开。
lines.en: Your foot is right beside me — move it.

lines.zh: 我一动，边上的草就湿了。
lines.en: When I move, the grass around me gets wet.

lines.zh: 我蹭到你脚边，试着粘一下。
lines.en: I slide to your feet and try to stick.
Your legs are at my edge.

lines.zh: 我跳起来的时候，你别挡。
lines.en: When I leap, don't block.
We split this ground in half.

lines.zh: 我摊开又收拢，边上缺了角。
lines.en: I flatten, gather, and my edge is missing a corner.
A piece of my rim is gone.
I shudder and water splashes.
One hit, and I bounce aside.

lines.zh: 我身体里那块被打散了。
lines.en: What was inside me scatters.
I don't cry out. I have no mouth.
It heals slowly.
I can still move, hop by hop.
I've grown thinner.
This will close up.

lines.zh: 你丢的东西，我让它沉底。
lines.en: Whatever you drop, I let it sink.

lines.zh: 你把东西丢进我身上也没用。
lines.en: Tossing it into me won't help.

lines.zh: 这东西会沉进我身体里。
lines.en: It would sink into my body.
I absorb. I don't chew.
You hold it; I shift over slowly.
That's too small.
I'm not picky at all.
You don't want to see how I eat.
It's dissolving inside me.
Toss a little more.
You hit me and I dent inward.
I spring back against your leg.

lines.zh: 你踩扁我，我从指缝里鼓回来。
lines.en: You squash me, and I swell back through your fingers.
My rim sticks to your boot.
You step away, and leave a wet mark.
I slide into a root.

lines.zh: 你撞进来，我裹住你的鞋。
lines.en: You push in, and I wrap around your boot.
You're half inside me.
I wobble and settle.

lines.zh: 这点碰撞，我连形都变了。
lines.en: That changed my shape a little.

lines.zh: 我被撞得像水一样散开。
lines.en: The hit scatters me like water.

lines.zh: 我滑过石头，留下一道湿。
lines.en: I slide over stone, leaving a wet streak.

lines.zh: 你的腿撞进我身体里了。
lines.en: Your leg sank into me.
I bounced off you with a smack.
Another blob is under the tree.

lines.zh: 我们靠在一起，合成一团。
lines.en: We press together into one mass.
A while later we come apart.
It's a little greener than me.

lines.zh: 我们的边撞在一起，弹开。
lines.en: Our edges bump and recoil.
We shift toward the low ground together.
Parted, each hops its own way.
Two wet patches remain.
After the next rain, we'll meet again.
There are many like us in this jungle.
I draw it inside me.
It hangs in the middle of me.
Too hard to absorb.
I wrap the pearl inside me.
The drops sink slowly.

lines.zh: 我用身体的一角把它卷住。
lines.en: I curl a corner of myself around it.
It dissolves a little, not all.
I push it to my edge.
I hop twice carrying it.
Something sloshes inside me.
That green under your foot is me.
I hop toward you.
This one will stick to you.

lines.zh: 我弹得慢，但每次都朝你。
lines.en: I hop slowly, but always toward you.
My body presses in.
You retreat; I hop again.
I've picked out your feet.
The jungle's damp helps me.
You have no torch.
I mean to trap you inside.

lines.zh: 你跑到树后，我也跳过去。
lines.en: You run behind a tree; I hop after.
My trail is on the ground.
You change course; I turn slowly.

lines.zh: 你走到哪，我的湿痕跟到哪。
lines.en: Wherever you walk, my wet trail follows.

lines.zh: 你的脚步把叶子踩响了。
lines.en: Your steps crackle the leaves.

lines.zh: 我只有弹跳声，一下一下。
lines.en: I make no cry, only a hop, hop, hop.

lines.zh: 你退到石头上，那里更滑。
lines.en: You're on stone. Slipperier there.
I can't hop far, but I never stop.
But I never stop hopping.
A vine has caught you.
I flatten out and cover your feet.
That stuck to your legs.
I leap and slam your chest.
My weight drags you down.
My rim cut your hand.
You're half inside me.
I wrap your ankle.

lines.zh: 你挣开的时候，带走了我一块。
lines.en: You tear free with a piece of me.
I swell again and press on.
You step back into a wet floor.
I swell up from under the leaves.
The jungle floor is wet. Good.

lines.zh: 我从湿叶堆里慢慢鼓起来。
lines.en: I swell up slowly out of the wet leaves.
One hop and I land here.
There's enough water here.
I settle by the roots.
My edge spreads slowly.

lines.zh: 有虫爬到我身上，我不管。
lines.en: A bug crawls on me. I ignore it.
Footsteps far off, coming closer.
This place is cool.

lines.zh: 火一靠近，我缩成一小团。
lines.en: When fire comes close, I shrink into a little ball.
On landing I spread wider.
I'm soaking wet already.

lines.zh: 爆风撕掉我一半，我又长回来。
lines.en: The blast tears half of me off, and I grow it back.

lines.zh: 箭从我这头进去，那头出来。
lines.en: The arrow goes in one side and out the other.
Light burns me from the inside out.
I grow smaller and thinner.
Lightning strikes; I shake into a puddle.
I come apart and fall in pieces.
